hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No visible street light poles or luminaires, which may create safety concerns for pedestrians after dark.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the street may obscure small children or pets entering the roadway from between vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked very close to the curb on the right, potentially narrowing the effective walking width of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the sidewalk and the roadway edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line at the bottom of the frame

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A parked vehicle in the foreground limits the visibility between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.

hazards.name: Debris on Walkway
hazards.description: A mattress and other discarded items block a significant portion of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image in the foreground.

hazards.name: Tripping hazard
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked, uneven, and has weeds growing through it, creating a risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Reduced natural surveillance
hazards.description: Boarded-up ground floor openings create a blank frontage, which can reduce the feeling of safety and actual security due to lack of 'eyes on the street'.
hazards.location_in_image: Ground floor of the brown building

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement and enforce policies to keep sidewalks clear of trash and private equipment to ensure an accessible path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at nearby intersections to improve pedestrian visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Active Frontage
interventions.description: Incorporate windows, murals, or architectural details into the blank wall to improve the pedestrian experience and natural surveillance.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is installed to improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours, especially given the blank frontage.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install bold, painted crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting on the building facade to improve visibility and perceived safety along the blank wall.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Introduce greenery to provide a buffer and improve the aesthetic quality of the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide shade and create a psychological narrowing effect that slows traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.
